hazards.evidence: The bed height appears inappropriate for someone using a walker after hip or knee replacement surgery, as it may be too low or too high for safe transfer.
Insufficient walker clearance around the bed, especially on the side closest to the wall and near the foot of the bed.
There appears to be a loose rug or mat near the foot of the bed, which could pose a tripping hazard.
The path from the bed to the bathroom may be dimly lit, increasing the risk of falls during nighttime navigation.
